package main

import (
	"context"
	"flag"
	"fmt"
	"log"
	"os"

	"github.com/example/ms-student-service/internal/migrations"
)

func main() {
	flags := flag.NewFlagSet("ms-student-migrate", flag.ExitOnError)
	directory := flags.String("dir", "db/migrations", "directory containing forward SQL migrations")
	if err := flags.Parse(os.Args[1:]); err != nil {
		log.Fatal(err)
	}
	if flags.NArg() != 1 {
		log.Fatal("usage: ms-student-migrate [-dir db/migrations] <status|up>")
	}

	ctx := context.Background()
	runner, err := migrations.New(ctx, os.Getenv("DATABASE_URL"), *directory)
	if err != nil {
		log.Fatal(err)
	}
	defer runner.Close()

	switch flags.Arg(0) {
	case "status":
		status, err := runner.Status(ctx)
		if err != nil {
			log.Fatal(err)
		}
		fmt.Println(migrations.PrintStatus(status))
	case "up":
		applied, err := runner.Up(ctx)
		if err != nil {
			log.Fatal(err)
		}
		for _, filename := range applied {
			fmt.Printf("applied=%s\n", filename)
		}
		status, err := runner.Status(ctx)
		if err != nil {
			log.Fatal(err)
		}
		fmt.Println(migrations.PrintStatus(status))
	default:
		log.Fatalf("unsupported command %q; use status or up", flags.Arg(0))
	}
}
